notes: Switch notifier and customer together, all instances at once, because queued offer events persist across deployments and the new customer opt-in rule must not run beside old notifier instances. Notifier re-checks customer.consent.check before every send, so queued events are safe after rollout. The daily cap is additive and uses the existing sent table plus offer_daily state. Roll back both services together; sent rows and cap state remain readable and a retry is safe.
